info.name: Copy Project from one organization to another

params.name: targetOrganizationID
params.description: Organization to copy the given site into.

params.name: siteName
params.description: Optionally change the copied site name.

params.name: siteDirectory
params.description: Optionally change the copied site directory.

params.name: startDate
params.description: Date to start copying history from. Required to export all history.

params.name: endDate
params.description: Date to end copying history at. Required to export all history.

items.docs:
Copies Project from one organization to a target organization given a project Identifier.
All UUID's are created new for the copied project.
Returns a mapping of old identifiers and new identifiers of the given project.
History data is NOT copied unless startDate and endDate are provided.
History copy will take time to complete in the background and there will be no indication of success.
